## Goal
- Close and verify GAP 1 only: enforce `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` `main` as the sole production mutation/deploy source via branch → PR → CI → merge → Render.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not work on any GAP other than GAP 1 until it is verified.
- Production repository: `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`; production branch: `main`; production host: Render.
- Reject autonomous direct commits to `main`, Git Data API writes to `main`, deploys from `ivx-autonomous`/unknown branches, deploys without PR/CI-pass/merge SHA, and completion without a Render deployment ID.
- Do not mutate production during QA while canonical GitHub/CI certification evidence is unavailable.
- Do not claim GitHub branch protection, required checks, PR, CI, or Render configuration proof without authorized direct evidence.
- Do not request or accept credentials pasted in chat.
- Required final response for the GAP 1 request: exactly `GAP_1_VERIFIED` or `GAP_1_FAILED`, with required evidence only if verified.

## Progress
### Done
- Confirmed public production availability:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health
  HTTP 200
  {
    "status":"healthy",
    "commit":"012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c",
    "environment":"production",
    "version":"ivx-owner-ai-backend-v2026.07.26",
    "bootTime":"2026-08-02T22:06:05.663Z",
    "service":"ivx-owner-ai-backend"
  }
  ```
- Confirmed unauthenticated sensitive endpoints reject access with HTTP 401 and do not expose credentials.
- Confirmed public chat is reachable:
  ```text
  POST /api/public/chat
  HTTP 200
  {"ok":true,"model":"ivx-ia-conversation-brain","commit":"012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c"}
  ```
- Confirmed PR-aware workflow intent exists in:
  ```text
  .github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml
  .github/workflows/ivx-qa-suite.yml
  ```
  with `push`/`pull_request` branches `[main]`.
- Located direct production mutation/deployment-sensitive code:
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`
    - `commitFilesToGithub(projectRoot, filePaths, branchOverride?)`
    - `getGithubBranchHead(branchOverride?)`
    - `triggerRenderDeploy(commitSha)`
    - branch derives from `branchOverride || GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH || GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH`.
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-git.ts`
    - standalone GitHub Contents API client intended to commit autonomous worker file changes.
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`
    - autonomous worker records commit/deploy evidence and maps completed results to `COMPLETED`.
  - `backend/services/ivx-task-orchestrator.ts`
    - invokes senior-developer runtime with `systemMode: true`.
  - `backend/services/ivx-owner-execution-mode.ts`
    - documents that `systemMode` auto-approves runtime patch and git/deploy gates for non-destructive commands.
  - `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`
    - exposes GitHub commit/branch/PR/merge and Render deploy control action types.
- Confirmed runtime approval bypass condition:
  ```ts
  const approved = input.systemMode === true || (
    input.approveGitDeploy === true &&
    input.gitDeployConfirmationText === IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_CONFIRM_TEXT
  );
  ```
- Existing focused policy tests were invoked:
  ```text
  bun test backend/tests/owner-ai-status-guard.test.ts backend/tests/ivx-github-path.test.ts backend/tests/ivx-deploy-dedup.test.ts --reporter=dots
  ```
  Result:
  ```text
  21 pass
  1 fail
  1 error
  65 expect() calls
  ```
  The failure was an environment/module-resolution error, not a stated policy assertion failure:
  ```text
  Cannot find module '@aws-sdk/client-acm' from '/home/user/rork-app/backend/api/ivx-audit-report.ts'
  ```

### In Progress
- Audit every production write/deploy path and create the requested path-ID inventory with file, function, route, credential source, branch, risk, and remediation.
- Harden canonical branch/PR/CI/merge/Render enforcement in runtime, worker, autonomous orchestration, and deploy-control paths.
- Add explicit regression tests for all eight requested rejection/completion conditions.
- Collect authorized GitHub and Render configuration evidence and perform a non-production branch/PR/CI proof.

### Blocked
- Canonical GitHub API is unavailable anonymously:
  ```text
  https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/commits/main
  HTTP 404
  ```
- Worker jobs endpoint requires authorized owner access:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs
  HTTP 401
  ```
- No authorized canonical GitHub token, PR creation authority, CI run access, branch-protection read access, or Render API/dashboard access is currently available.
- `RENDER_API_KEY` is unavailable in this workspace.
- Typecheck cannot start in the current dependency layout:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'bun'.
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'node'.
  ```
- Local test environment cannot fully load backend modules because:
  ```text
  Cannot find module '@aws-sdk/client-acm' from '/home/user/rork-app/backend/api/ivx-audit-report.ts'
  ```
- GAP 1 cannot be declared verified without a safe branch, PR URL, CI run ID, branch-protection evidence, Render branch evidence, and confirmation of alternate-path closure.

## Key Decisions
- Restrict all current work to GAP 1; defer IA/autonomous deep-QA gaps until canonical production source-of-truth enforcement is verified.
- Treat repository workflow YAML and `render.yaml` as implementation intent only, not live GitHub/Render configuration proof.
- Do not create a branch, PR, commit, deploy, or production mutation through the Rork-router remote.
- Preserve evidence requirements: production completion must require canonical merged `main` SHA and non-null Render deployment ID.
- Remove `systemMode` as an implicit production mutation/deploy bypass; autonomous orchestration may inspect/prepare work but cannot bypass canonical PR/CI/merge requirements.

## Next Steps
1. Finish source audit across runtime, Git service, worker, executor, API control routes, deployment engines, tool engines, and all GitHub/Render credential reads.
2. Introduce a centralized canonical-production policy guard for repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`, source branch allowlist, PR target `main`, CI-pass, merge SHA, and Render `main` requirements.
3. Modify direct Git Data/Contents commit paths to reject `main` and only permit approved temporary PR branches.
4. Modify deploy paths to reject `ivx-autonomous`, unknown/non-`main` branches, missing PR, non-passing CI, missing merge SHA, and missing Render deployment ID.
5. Ensure worker status cannot become `completed`/`COMPLETED` without verified merged-main SHA and Render deployment ID.
6. Add the eight required enforcement tests and repair local test dependency resolution sufficiently to run them.
7. With authorized GitHub/Render access, inspect default branch, branch protection/rulesets, required checks, Render branch, deploy hooks, and alternate branch settings.
8. With authorized non-production credentials, create a harmless branch and PR; capture PR URL and CI run ID; prove direct `main` mutation rejection and pre-merge deploy non-triggering.
9. Return `GAP_1_VERIFIED` only if all required implementation, test, GitHub, Render, and safe-proof evidence exists; otherwise return `GAP_1_FAILED`.

## Critical Context
- Required canonical production flow:
  ```text
  ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
  main
  branch → PR → CI → merge → Render deploy
  ```
- Live production currently reports:
  ```text
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  renderServiceId=srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  ```
- The local workspace remote is not canonical GitHub:
  ```text
  origin https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` currently has direct GitHub mutation capability through `commitFilesToGithub(...)`; its `branchOverride` and `GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH` behavior must be constrained.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-git.ts` currently documents a GitHub Contents API commit path using:
  ```text
  GITHUB_TOKEN
  GITHUB_REPO_URL or GITHUB_OWNER + GITHUB_REPO
  GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH
  ```
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` has an explicit fallback:
  ```ts
  deployStatus: 'auto_deploy_on_commit',
  autoDeployFallback: true,
  ```
  This is incompatible with strict proof that production deploy completion has a Render deployment ID.
- `backend/services/ivx-task-orchestrator.ts` calls runtime with:
  ```ts
  systemMode: true
  ```
  and runtime treats this as approval for patch/deploy gates; this is a GAP 1 bypass target.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` stage model:
  ```text
  QUEUED → RUNNING → PATCHING → TESTING → COMMITTING → DEPLOYING → VERIFYING → COMPLETED/FAILED
  ```
- Worker cancellation currently writes:
  ```ts
  status: 'cancelled',
  stage: 'FAILED',
  ```
  This is a separate state-consistency concern, but should not distract from GAP 1.
- QA scripts have inconsistent owner token locations:
  ```text
  qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts → tmp/owner_token.txt
  ivx_20step_test.py → /tmp/owner_token.txt
  ```
  This is outside GAP 1 unless it blocks canonical enforcement test execution.

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`: direct GitHub commit/ref handling, branch selection, Render deployment trigger, deploy fallback, and approval bypass.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-git.ts`: GitHub Contents API client and GitHub credential/branch environment handling.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: autonomous worker lifecycle, commit/deploy proof, completion state, cancellation behavior.
- `backend/services/ivx-task-orchestrator.ts`: system-mode autonomous execution path.
- `backend/services/ivx-owner-execution-mode.ts`: owner command classification and system-mode auto-approval rationale.
- `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`: owner-gated GitHub/Render deployment control actions.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`: authenticated runtime job request path and active-job attachment behavior.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: worker request approval-contract validation and internal authorization metadata.
- `backend/tests/ivx-github-path.test.ts`: existing GitHub write/ref policy regression coverage.
- `backend/tests/ivx-deploy-dedup.test.ts`: existing Render deployment deduplication/policy coverage.
- `backend/tests/owner-ai-status-guard.test.ts`: owner status authentication/public-safe response regression coverage.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: PR and `main` E2E/typecheck/lint workflow intent.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-qa-suite.yml`: PR and `main` backend/expo/critical-file QA workflow intent.
- `render.yaml`: declarative canonical repository and `branch: main` intent.
- `qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts`: QA matrix and owner-token lookup.
- `qa/ivx-evidence-generator.ts`: production evidence generation and emergency-login QA path.
